entries.translation: Stile chì porti. Cultura chì porti cun tè.
entries.note: Informal singular; balanced repetition; speaker polish advised.

entries.translation: kikiska kitisinâkosiwin. pimohtata kitisîhcikêwin.
entries.note: Plains Cree SRO; imperative ‘wear your look’; native approval essential.

entries.translation: Styl, který nosíš. Kultura, kterou v sobě neseš.
entries.note: Informal singular; ‘within yourself’ conveys embodiment.

entries.translation: Stil, du bærer. Kultur, du bærer med dig.
entries.note: Informal singular; bære wordplay preserved.

entries.translation: ތިބާ ލާ ސްޓައިލް. ތިބާ ގެންގުޅޭ ސަގާފަތް.
entries.transliteration: Thibaa laa staail. Thibaa gengulhey sagaafaiy.
entries.note: Standard Malé Dhivehi; established style loan; native review needed.

entries.translation: Stijl die je draagt. Cultuur die je uitdraagt.
entries.note: Informal singular; uitdragen means embody or express.

entries.translation: ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་གྱོན་པའི་བཟོ་རྣམ། ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས་འབག་པའི་ལམ་སྲོལ།
entries.transliteration: khyod kyis gyon pa'i bzo rnam. khyod kyis 'bag pa'i lam srol.
entries.note: Standard Dzongkha; Wylie transliteration; native review essential.

entries.translation: Style you wear. Culture you carry.
entries.note: Canonical source wording.

entries.translation: Stilo, kiun vi portas. Kulturo, kiun vi kunportas.
entries.note: Kunporti means carry along or with oneself.

entries.translation: Stiil, mida kannad. Kultuur, mida endas kannad.
entries.note: Informal singular; endas makes embodiment explicit.

entries.translation: Atsia si nèdo lá. Dekɔnu si nètsɔ lá.
entries.note: Standard Ewe practical orthography; tone and slogan rhythm merit review.

entries.translation: Stílur, sum tú ber. Mentan, sum tú ber við tær.
entries.note: Informal singular; bera wordplay preserved.

entries.translation: Na ivakarau o daramaka. Na itovo vakavanua o kauta voli.
entries.note: Standard Bauan Fijian; kauta voli conveys carrying onward or along.

entries.translation: Tyyli, jota kannat. Kulttuuri, jota kannat mukanasi.
entries.note: Literary kannat sustains the wear/carry wordplay.

entries.translation: Le style que tu portes. La culture que tu incarnes.
entries.note: Tutoiement; incarnes avoids a physical-hauling interpretation.

entries.translation: Styl dy'tsto draachst. Kultuer dy'tsto útdraachst.
entries.note: Informal singular; útdrage means embody or express.

entries.translation: Ɓorno moodu maa. Ronndo finaa-tawaa maa.
entries.note: Fuuta Jaloo Pular Latin chosen; imperative transcreation; native review essential.

entries.translation: სტილი, რომელსაც ატარებ. კულტურა, რომელსაც თან ატარებ.
entries.transliteration: Stili, romelsats atareb. Kultura, romelsats tan atareb.
entries.note: Informal singular; თან supplies the ‘with you’ sense.

entries.translation: Stil, den du trägst. Kultur, die du in dir trägst.
entries.note: Informal singular; in dir conveys lived identity.

entries.translation: Stoidhle a chaitheas tu. Cultar a ghiùlaineas tu leat.
entries.note: Informal singular; habitual relative forms; speaker polish advised.

entries.translation: Stíl a chaitheann tú. Cultúr a iompraíonn tú leat.
entries.note: Informal singular; natural wear/carry contrast.

entries.translation: Estilo que levas. Cultura que levas contigo.
entries.note: Informal singular; levar repetition sounds natural.

entries.translation: Aght t'ou ceau. Cultoor t'ou gymmyrkey mayrt.
entries.note: Modern standard Manx; mayrt means ‘with you’; speaker review advised.

entries.translation: Στιλ που φοράς. Κουλτούρα που κουβαλάς.
entries.transliteration: Stil pou forás. Koultúra pou kouvalás.
entries.note: Informal singular; standard loans; internal rhyme preserved.

entries.translation: Estílo remondéva. Arandupy regueraháva nendive.
entries.note: Standard Paraguayan Guaraní; established style loan; speaker review advised.

entries.translation: તમારી શૈલી પહેરો. તમારી સંસ્કૃતિ સાથે લઈને ચાલો.
entries.transliteration: Tamārī śailī pahero. Tamārī saṃskr̥ti sāthe laīne cālo.
entries.note: Polite imperative transcreation; native campaign cadence still requires review.

entries.translation: Stil ou mete. Kilti ou pote.
entries.note: Direct, balanced colloquial syntax.

entries.translation: Salon da kuke sanyawa. Al’adun da kuke ɗauke da su.
entries.note: Respectful or plural generic ‘you’; plural culture agreement.

entries.translation: סגנון שאתם לובשים. תרבות שאתם נושאים איתכם.
entries.transliteration: Signon she’atem lovshim. Tarbut she’atem nos’im itchem.
entries.note: Generic masculine plural; gender-neutral infinitive variant possible.

entries.translation: Omuhingo mbu mo zara. Ombazu ndji mo twara pamwe na ove.
entries.note: Standard Otjiherero; relative-concord draft; native approval essential.

entries.translation: पहनें अपना अंदाज़। साथ लेकर चलें अपनी संस्कृति।
entries.transliteration: Pahneṁ apnā andāz. Sāth lekar caleṁ apnī saṃskr̥ti.
entries.note: Polite imperative transcreation.
